name: Data Center El Cebollar
notes: Cuenca data center; Uptime lists ETAPA E.P. Data Center El Cebollar in Cuenca with Tier III design-document certification. DCD reported inauguration, USD 7m investment, 980 sq m built area, and hosting for public/private organizations.

name: Puntonet Data Center Cuenca
notes: Datacenters.com lists a Puntonet Data Center Cuenca in Cuenca, Azuay. Puntonet official company history confirms operation of data centers/cloud infrastructure in Ecuador, but the Cuenca facility detail is from an aggregator.

name: ESPOCH institutional data center
notes: Weak institutional/social source indicates a new ESPOCH data center in Chimborazo; included as a small non-colocation institutional center, not a hyperscale/colo project.

name: Sala Huayna Capac data center
notes: Ekos article describes Banco del Austro's sustainable data-center project Sala Huayna Capac in Machala; source snippet places it in Machala, El Oro, but full page was not readable via crawler.

name: Universidad Tecnica de Machala data center
notes: ESPOL repository thesis documents continuity planning for services provided by the Universidad Tecnica de Machala data center; institutional/non-colocation facility.

name: Puntonet Data Center Santa Cruz / Galapagos
notes: Datacenters.com lists a Puntonet data center in Santa Cruz, Galapagos. Puntonet official history separately confirms Galapagos O3B satellite platform and construction of data centers as company projects.

name: Telconet Cloud Center I - Guayaquil
notes: Uptime lists Telconet Cloud Center I in Guayaquil with Tier IV design and constructed-facility certifications; DataCenterMap lists the facility at ESPOL/Leopoldo Carrera Calvo in Guayaquil.

name: Centro de Datos CNT EP - Guayaquil
developer: Corporacion Nacional de Telecomunicaciones CNT E.P.
notes: CNT Guayaquil has Uptime Tier III design and constructed-facility certifications. Nearshore Americas reported construction of Quito and Guayaquil data centers with USD 36m allocated, about 180 racks each.

name: UFINET Ciudad Digital
notes: Uptime lists CIUDAD DIGITAL UFINET NEDETEL in Guayaquil with Tier III design and constructed-facility certifications; DataCenterMap lists it on Av. Perimetral / Francisco de Orellana.

name: Cirion GUA1
notes: DataCenterMap lists Cirion GUA1 in Guayaquil at Km 30.5 Via Perimetral; Baxtel lists Cirion Ecuador Guayaquil among Ecuador facilities. Aggregator-backed facility record.

name: Data Xperience Center Duran
notes: Uptime lists Conecel S.A. Data Xperience Center Duran, location Guayaquil, Ecuador, with Tier III design and constructed-facility certifications. Duran is in Guayas province.

name: Puntonet Data Center Guayaquil
notes: Datacenters.com lists Puntonet Data Center Guayaquil. Puntonet official company history says it implemented cloud computing and data centers in Quito and Guayaquil during 2011-2013.

name: Puntonet planned Guayaquil data center
notes: DCD reports Puntonet's 2026-2027 investment plan includes two additional data centers in Quito and Guayaquil, alongside Epicentro in Quito; treated as planned Guayaquil expansion with no disclosed capacity.
